new: local back_to_shop = G.STATE == G.STATES.SHOP or G.STATE == G.STATES.BLIND_SELECT -- fix: tag packs
why: A booster opened by a skip tag closes back to BLIND_SELECT, not SHOP; the request never answered.

new: local needs_hand = (card.key or ""):find("arcana") ~= nil or (card.key or ""):find("spectral") ~= nil -- fix: pack type
why: Whether to wait for the hand was decided by the first card's set; a Celestial pack whose first card is Black Hole (Spectral) waited forever for a hand that is never dealt.

new: local count_decreased = (current_area.config.card_count <= initial_count) -- fix: Invisible Joker
why: Selling Invisible Joker duplicates another joker, so the joker count does not drop; the request never answered. The sold card being gone and the payout are still checked.

new:
local needs_hand = pack_key == "Spectral" -- fix: pack type, not the first card
    for _, c in ipairs(G.pack_cards and G.pack_cards.cards or {}) do
      local s = c.ability and c.ability.set
      if s == "Tarot" or s == "Planet" then needs_hand = s == "Tarot"; break end
    end
why: Same as the buy fix, when taking a card: a Celestial pack whose first card is Black Hole (Spectral) waited forever for a hand. A Tarot means an Arcana pack (hand dealt), a Planet a Celestial pack (no hand); otherwise only Spectral packs deal one.
